verdict.rationale: Shopify Tax documents automated US sales tax calculations, liability insights, and filing and remittance from within the admin. That covers the US sales-tax and filing parts of the story. The evidence is limited to the United States, though, and never mentions VAT or keeping rates current. missing for 10: VAT/international tax calculation evidence, explicit per-jurisdiction rate maintenance/updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
